data.name: Iron Web Entrapment
data.description: Conjure magnetic wires to trap your opponent, slowing their resolve.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the ground, causing razor-sharp wires to erupt and form a vast web across the battlefield. The wires ensnare %target and nearby enemies, tightening with each movement, slicing through armor and flesh.

data.name: Wire Blast Plus
data.description: Itojinsei's Wind Style: Wire Blast
data.battleDescription: %user channels Wind element to their steel wire bundle, %user hurtles their sharpened wire ball at %target the wires exploding on impact.

data.name: Spiraling Wires
data.description: This Itojinsei jutsu spears their target making them work harder to defend themselves.
data.battleDescription: %user launches out multiple shuriken with wiries attached to them weaving them in an intricate pattern the shuriken strikes %target in their vital spots impairing their movement

data.name: Lightning Threads
data.description: Infuse lightning chakra into thin, thread-sharp wires to deliver lethal shocks.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate dome-shaped cage made entirely of wires around %target. The wires tighten and constrict, restricting the target's movement and preventing escape. %user infuses lightning chakra into the wires to electrocute %target.

data.name: Eternal Embrace
data.description: The user conjures thin, razor-sharp wires, imbuing them with chakra. These wires can be controlled with precision, used for stealthy assassinations or to create intricate traps.
data.battleDescription: %user performs Wire Strangle. Thin wires materialize, dancing with deadly grace, hurtles towards %target. %target is ensnared, the wires tightening with precision, leaving them incapacitated, and cutting deeply as %target struggles under the wires.

data.name: Itojinsei
data.description:
The Itojinsei bloodline originates from a lineage of skilled craftsmen and artisans who specialized in the creation and manipulation of wires. With generations of honed craftsmanship, the bloodline developed a unique connection to wires, unlocking a profound ability to control and utilize them in combat. This bloodline's members were revered for their precise wirework, becoming feared and respected warriors on the battlefield.


Many have attempted in the past to match the skills of these artisans, but their mystical connection to Seichi's magnetic field makes them unique in their abilities. Despite efforts to replicate their techniques, none have achieved the same level of mastery. Their creations are even considered works of art by some, admired for the precision and beauty with which they are crafted.

data.name: Temporal Erosion
data.description: Rapidly accelerates the target's timeline, causing them to decay and erode into dust.
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, pulling particles from the surrounding air that shimmer with an otherworldly glow. The particles coalesce into jagged shards that gleam with distorted time energy. With a swift motion, %user launches the fragments at %target. The shards tear through the air, bending light and warping space as they collide with %target

data.name: Abysmal End
data.description: This jutsu creates a spiral of dust and air enveloping the enemy and collapsing against them with overwhelming force.
data.battleDescription: %user engulfs %target in a spiral of dust, sapping their strength while boosting their own before collapsing it with devastating force.

data.name: Singularity
data.description: A Jutsu that displays the symbolism of the Kyuko-sei. The user manipulates fine dust particles infused with chakra, creating a volatile field that detonates upon command. This technique disperses microscopic shards that pierce targets,
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful gravitational core, tearing into %target and amplifying Dust, Wind, and Earth techniques

data.name: Resonance
data.description: Surround yourself with a dust-infused resonance that reflects incoming force and damages the target.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a dust-infused pulse that reverberates around them, reflecting incoming force before striking %target.

data.name: Ethereal Particle Storm
data.description: The user unleashes a storm of charged particles imbued with temporal energy, blanketing the battlefield. These particles create unstable time zones where objects and enemies fluctuate between accelerated and decelerated states, creating chaos and opportunity.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a shimmering cloud of dust particles that engulf %target, eroding their ability to strike effectively.

data.name: Kyuko-sei
data.description:
In the depths of legend, the tale of the Kyuko-sei bloodline is inscribed with blood and ink upon a parchment guarded within the Temple of Izanagi. It recounts the story of Kyuko, a master of Ninjutsu, who witnessed her brother poised to seize the leadership rightfully hers upon their father's demise. Determined not to succumb to defeat, she infused her chakra with a Stone of Heraldry, renowned for its ability to cleanse one's bloodline. Once this bond was forged, she bestowed the stone upon her brother's wife, scion of the Endless Erosion family, in the form of an amulet.

 

She accepted the gift and wore it around her neck, unaware that the stone was draining the strength of her bloodline. However, instead of dissipating, this power flowed into Kyuko through the connection she had forged, granting her the strength to vanquish her brother. Thus began the lineage of Kyuko-sei, rising mighty in the mastery of wind and earth.

data.name: Possessing Yurei
data.description: Summoning up a Yurei from the underworld to possess the target
data.battleDescription: %target finds they've lost most control over their body as they are dominated by this otherworldly creature.

data.name: Oni Hammer Swing
data.description: Opening a portal to the underworld, a large hand juts out to attack
data.battleDescription: %user summons a large portal from which a giant hand shoots out slamming down on %target

data.name: Otherworldly Conduit
data.description: Your body is a lightning rod for otherworldly chakra. You've learned to harness it to empower yourself.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the underworld into their own body drastically improving their abilities.

data.name: Summoning: Underworld Gate
data.description: A giant gateway through which beings can cross over. Only needs to be trained once.
data.battleDescription: %user pricks their finger on one of their weapons to draw blood. Using that blood they summon a giant gateway.

data.name: Herald of the Black Night
data.description: A technique that covers the battlefield in a shadowy portal to the world of yokai.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a praying motion as a shadowy mist flows from beneath them covering the entire battlefield.

data.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons
data.description: Long ago a small village was under threat of destruction. Sandwiched between 3 warring nations, each sought to claim the village as their own and demanded the chief swear loyalty to them. However, the chief knew that swearing loyalty to any one would spell destruction as the other two would surely attack. Secretly, he tasked his only daughter to go find help, but no one wanted to get involved and risk war from the 3 powerful nations. So, she turned to the only place she could, the underworld. She began making summoning contracts with smaller lesser powerful beasts, collecting allies until she had enough strength to recruit more powerful entities. And when she was finally done, she had amassed a force nearing a thousand. 999 Demons had made a contract with her, offering up a portion of their power. When the deadline came for the village chief to swear loyalty, his daughter returned with her new found power and struck down the ambassadors of each nation. Normally, this would mean eradication, however, she had become so powerful that she was able to take on the forces of all 3 nations with her summoned demons. When the dust cleared, all 3 nations were no more and that small village had annexed them all. Unfortunately, however, the village chief's daughter had to pay the ultimate price. By overusing the powers granted to her, she had, tragically, become a demon herself. The village chief had to seal her and her army away into his own granddaughter. With time and many wars, the village eventually was destroyed and the seal gradually weakened. Now on the night of a lunar eclipse, the moon tinted blood red, the seal finally broke and the Night Parade begins.

data.name: Shadowrend
data.description: Cursed tattoos allow the user’s strike to ignore defenses and inflict a shadow curse.
data.battleDescription: With a pulse of malevolent chakra, %user's cursed tattoos flare to life, filling the air with shadowy energy. They strike at %target, bypassing all armor and barriers, as the cursed shadows cling to %target, seeping into their chakra network. This curse lingers in %target's system, amplifying the damage of future attacks. The shadows coil tightly around %target, ensuring that the next hit they suffer will be devastating, as the curse grows more potent with each passing moment.

data.name: Cursed Beast Form
data.description: The cursed tattoos fully cover the user, turning them into a creature of the shadows.
data.battleDescription: With a dark incantation, %user activates the full power of their cursed tattoos, which crawl across their skin like living ink. The tattoos pulse with malevolent energy, overtaking %user’s entire form and warping them into a monstrous shadow creature. Claws extend from their hands, and their body becomes wreathed in dark energy. In this form, %user’s strength, speed, and resilience increase dramatically, their attacks leaving trails of shadow that cling to %target like a curse.

data.name: Curse Empowerment
data.description: The user absorbs dark energy from cursed tattoos, amplifying their strength.
data.battleDescription: The cursed tattoos etched across %user’s body glow with ominous energy, drawing on the surrounding shadows to fuel their strength. As they attack %target, the dark tendrils of cursed energy lash out, not only delivering pain but channeling that energy back into %user.

data.name: Shadow Tether
data.description: Glowing tattoos summon shadows that deal a devastating wound to enemies
data.battleDescription: %user’s tattoos glow as living shadows stretch toward %target and tighten around them. The tether tears into %target, leaving a deep wound that makes every movement more painful.

data.name: Shadow Surge
data.description: The user bonds with shadows, teleporting to a target while taking reduced damage.
data.battleDescription: %user's tattoos glow a deep, ominous hue, their body dissolving partially into shadows. Vanishing from their position and reappearing beside the opponent. Cloaked in shadow, %user seems to shrug off attacks, the damage lessened as their form becomes one with the darkness.

data.name: Oblivion Seal
data.description:
In the underbelly of Seichi, whispers tell of the Oblivion Seal, a cursed bloodline crafted by outlaw shinobi who willingly sacrifice their original lineage for control over shadows. This horrifying transformation is achieved through intricate rituals, during which shadow-tattoos, imbued with ancient and forbidden jutsu, are etched into the user’s skin. These living tattoos crawl across the body, constantly shifting and pulsating with dark energy.

Wielders of the Oblivion Seal are often shunned by society, as the process of obtaining this power is both dangerous and taboo. The Seal locks away the user’s original bloodline abilities, leaving them bound to the shadows. With this transformation, they become masters of the Void, capable of manipulating shadows in ways that strike terror into the hearts of their enemies. However, this power comes at a cost: the Seal grows stronger as it consumes the user’s chakra, gradually eroding their own power and leaving them dependent on the seal.

data.name: Timelapse
data.description: Timelapse is a high-level temporal sand jutsu that manipulates the perception and flow of time within a confined area.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, releasing a spiraling formation of fine, golden sand that coils upward like an inverted hourglass. The sand rotates in slow, deliberate motion, suspended in the air slowing %targets attack

data.name: Timeshift
data.description: Timeshift is an aggressive counterpart to Timelapse, embodying the destructive side of time rather than its restraint.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps their hands together, compressing sand infused with volatile temporal chakra before hurling it toward %target. Upon impact, the sand erupts into a fractured hourglass formation around the enemy, spinning violently as if time itself has been forced to accelerate

data.name: Eternity Flux
data.description: Eternity Flux is a precision-based sand jutsu that weaponizes a single, endless instant.
data.battleDescription: %user draws sand into a tight, orbiting ring around their arm, compressing it until the grains vibrate with unstable chronal energy. With a sharp forward motion, the sand is released in a linear burst, striking the %target

data.name: Cellular Regeneration
data.description: The caster cast a barrier around themselves using time to heal their wounds
data.battleDescription: %user draws sand into a slow, circular flow around their body, forming a protective barrier and healing their injuries

data.name: Momentum Shift
data.description: Momentum Shift is a devastating control-oriented time jutsu that attacks the concept of motion itself.
data.battleDescription: As %target moves  %user snaps their hand forward, releasing a burst of tightly compressed sand infused with chakra. The sand collides with the %target’s halting their movement

data.name: Sands of Time
data.description: Rank Reward Bloodline

data.name: Shadow Domain
data.description: A devastating shadow-infused attack that merges Yin and Yang energy with shadow manipulation, delivering a lethal blow that drains the opponent's vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning the surrounding shadows to converge around %target. The shadows twist and elongate, forming sharp, ethereal blades that glint with a dark aura. With a swift motion, %user launches the shadows at %target. As the strike connects, the shadowy blades seep into %target's body

data.name: Shadow Severance
data.description: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness. Through swift and precise movements, the user delivers strikes that sever both the physical form and the shadow of the target, leaving them without identity or substance.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline, asserting dominance over %target's shadow. Emerging from the darkness, a scythe materializes, a manifestation of the shadow's chilling embrace. With unparalleled speed and precision, %user delivers devastating strikes, severing both the physical form and the shadow of %target, leaving them without an identity, a mere shell of their former self.

data.name: Shadow Step
data.description: A skillful maneuver that blurs the boundaries between visibility and concealment. Through an artful melding with the enveloping shadows, the practitioner's presence becomes near-invisible, seamlessly blending into the darkness that surrounds them
data.battleDescription: %user seamlessly melds with nearby shadows, becoming an elusive wraith in the dimness. Swift as a moonlit breeze, they materialize in a surge of shadow energy just behind the opponent. Seizing the advantage of stealth, %user initiates an ambush with heightened potency, catching the opponent off guard and delivering a forceful strike that inflicts substantial damage.

data.name: Shadow Shell
data.description: Becoming one with the Shadows gives this Shinobi the edge they need in battle.
data.battleDescription: %user envelopes themselves in darkness as their power reinvigorates %user becomes a pillar of shadows imposing a menacing figure as the battle continues.

data.name: Shadow Dance
data.description: A mesmerizing spectacle unfolds as the wielder's weapon becomes an integral part of their very essence. This intricate choreography of combat seamlessly melds martial finesse with the power of the Shadow Weaver bloodline.
data.battleDescription: %user's weapon becomes an extension of their body as they engage in a mesmerizing dance of combat. With swift, rhythmic movements, %user strikes and slashes, each motion releasing bursts of shadow energy that cascade toward %target, inflicting a series of rapid and devastating blows. The seamless fusion of %user's mastery over shadows and their weapon creates a captivating and lethal performance on the battlefield.

data.name: Shadow Weaver
data.description:
The Shadow Weaver Bloodline, steeped in the shadows of antiquity, remains an enigmatic tapestry woven with threads of mystery. Whispers of its origins echo through the corridors of time, yet the truth remains veiled in obscurity. How this lineage acquired its innate mastery over the elements of Lightning, Fire, and Shadow is a riddle that eludes even the most learned scholars of the arcane arts. Nevertheless, what cannot be denied is the unparalleled skill and mastery displayed by its practitioners in the art of bukijutsu.


Those who bear the mantle of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline are not merely wielders of shadows; they are artists who shape darkness into lethal instruments of war. With a flick of their wrist and a whispered incantation, they conjure forth shadowy weapons that dance and writhe with a life of their own. It is said that their connection to the essence of shadows runs deep within their very souls, granting them an intuitive understanding of the ebb and flow of darkness. In the heat of battle, they are a sight to behold, weaving shadows into a deadly symphony that strikes fear into the hearts of their foes.

data.name: Yozakura: Sakura Dragon Pearl
data.description: As wind and fire chakra converge, a glowing sphere takes shape, pulsing in resonance with the Sakura Dragon Tree. Petals spiral inward, fusing into a radiant pearl that enters the user’s body, igniting a healing fire that restores balance and strength from within.
data.battleDescription: %user forming a glowing pearl of flame and petal light that surges into their chest, reigniting their strength before %target can strike again.

data.name: Yozakura: Dancing Embers
data.description: A storm of wind chakra whips through the flame blossoms of the Sakura Dragon Tree, lifting them into a blinding violet blaze. The swirling torrent surges forward like dancing dragons, leaving scorched trails and reduced damage in their wake.
data.battleDescription: %user stirring the flame blossoms into a violent vortex that lashes out at %target in a blazing spiral.

data.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakuragari
data.description: A spiraling lance of burning cherry blossom petals forms from the swirling wind, hurled with violent force toward the enemy. Just before impact, the lance blossoms apart into a storm of flaming petals, searing everything in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user uses Hiru-Sakura: Sakuragari, forming a lance of swirling petals that shatters near %target into a wave of burning blossoms.

data.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakura-ame
data.description: Infusing chakra into a cloud above their opponent, the user is able to make it rain blossom petals that distort enemy senses.
data.battleDescription: %user infuses their chakra into a cloud above %target gradually changing the cloud's color into a mix of pink and violet, %user clenches their hand as an extreme amount of blossom petals begin fall from the cloud like rain, overwhelming %target senses

data.name: Asazakura – Sakura Dragon Tree
data.description:
Summons the legendary Sakura Dragon Tree—its darkened trunk erupting from the battlefield, crowned in blazing pink and violet flame blossoms.

The tree remains rooted in place, scorching nearby enemies and empowering all fire and scorch-based techniques used by the caster. Its presence marks the battlefield with beauty and devastation alike.

A symbol of rebirth and destruction, this is the first blossom of the Nikko no Hana's legacy.
data.battleDescription: Flames blossom from the earth as %user casting burning petals toward %target in a dazzling display of wrath and grace.

data.name: Shakunetsu Sakura
data.description:
To know the Nikko no Hana lineage is to know the Sakura Dragon's Tree—for they are its avatars.

The ancestors of the Nikko no Hana lineage were blessed with the flames of the Sakura Dragon Tree, giving birth to their unique pink and violet fire release, along with an affinity for wind release.

Those who belong to this lineage possess absolute control over flame and wind, shaping embers into blossom petals and luring their foes into the dance of searing, violet-pink flame blossoms swirling on the breeze. These petals leave nothing but scorched earth for those who underestimate their beauty.

Rising like the first rays of daylight after a lightless night, the Nikko no Hana seek to astound the world with their scorching flames once more.

data.name: Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder
data.description: Unleashes a torrent of electrified water, overwhelming enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands to the sky, gathering their chakra and calling forth a massive storm. With a swift motion, %user brings their hands down, summoning a torrential wave of water infused with lightning. The wave crashes toward %target, the water swirling violently as bolts of lightning strike from within, making escape nearly impossible. As the electrified water engulfs %target, the intense shock and pressure from the current deal devastating damage. The storm rages for a few moments, leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual electrical energy, hindering actions.

data.name: Izanagi's Hammer
data.description: Brings down a lightning-infused hammer to crush all in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user summons the divine power of Izanagi’s hammer, using it to rapidly close the distance, smashing %target

data.name: Indra's Storm Cloak
data.description: You cover your body in lightning and water chakra causing those that attack you to be struck in return
data.battleDescription: %user cloaks themselves in their storm chakra; using themselves as the epicenter lightning strikes the battlefield

data.name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun
data.description: You fire off an attack at inhuman speeds utilizing the properties of lightning and water's conductivity.
data.battleDescription: %user coats small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

data.name: Strike: Raijin
data.description: The culmination of your Bloodline limit, you create thunderclouds above the battlefield that rain down lightning indiscriminately, destroying everything.
data.battleDescription: %user summons up thunderclouds in the sky, charging their body with chakra, they disappear from the field of battle and strike down from the heavens on %target

data.name: Shinrai Ou
data.description:
Their mastery over the mysterious Storm element gave them a natural command of lightning and water. Their power was revered, people called them one of two monikers: The Divine Thunder and The Kings of Water. Thus, they adopted the name Shinrai Ou, meaning "Divine Thunder King" to reflect the title bestowed upon them. Their original name has since been lost to time.
Currently, the descendants of this bloodline are famous throughout Seichi for their incredible skill and control over their powers. Heroes to some and villains to others, the members of this bloodline are both hated and respected equally, and their potential seems limitless. Yet, regardless of the varied opinions, none can deny the impact they have had on the world around them.

Whether their legacy will be one of salvation or destruction remains to be seen, but one thing is certain: the Shinrai Ou are destined to be remembered for ages to come.
